title: SurtaxOrder
description: One line of a surtax order: a percentage of value for duty applied to goods of a given origin whose tariff code starts with hs_prefix, for a date range.

pct.description: Percentage of value for duty, as a decimal string.

effective_to.description: Exclusive: a measure with effective_to = D is not in force on D. Null means open-ended. A source that states an inclusive end date is normalised by its connector to the day after. When a string, must not be before effective_from (semantic rule).

authority.description: Legal authority for the measure. Known values: s53, 232, 301, 338, 122, 201, adcvd. Not enumerated; other values are allowed.

basis.description: What the percentage applies to. Defaults to value when absent. Values other than value require a content value that the landed-cost request does not yet carry: a consumer that lacks it must refuse to compute (TradeLattice returns 422 surtax_content_basis), never apply the rate to the full value.

exempt_if.description: Condition under which the goods are exempt from this surtax.

stacking.description: Declared, not computed. Whether this surtax adds to other orders that apply to the same goods (additive) or excludes them (exclusive). Absent means unspecified. A consumer that does not implement stacking must refuse to compute when more than one order applies to a line (TradeLattice returns 422 surtax_ambiguous), never pick one.
